terminal_record.title: Unverified claim: FBI surveillance of protest organizers
terminal_record.description_short: The supplied record alleges a February 2025 FBI directive to monitor protest organizers as potential domestic terrorists.
terminal_record.description_medium: The frozen record alleges that Trump directed the FBI in February 2025 to monitor protest organizers and classify them as potential domestic terrorists. It also alleges cases under FBI Director Kash Patel and monitoring of organizers’ communications, finances, and associations. The packet supplies no directive, case records, named subjects, source URLs, or contemporaneous excerpts, so the event, scope, date, and claimed surveillance remain unverified.
terminal_record.description_long: This internal draft records an unverified allegation in the supplied entry. It says President Donald Trump directed the FBI in February 2025 to monitor organizers of protests against administration policies and classify them as potential domestic terrorists. It further alleges that, under FBI Director Kash Patel, the bureau opened cases and monitored organizers’ communications, financial transactions, and associations, and that civil liberties organizations objected to files on people engaged in lawful political activity. The packet provides no directive, case number, identified organizer, protest, classification record, source URL, or contemporaneous report supporting those claims. The exact date, scope, legal basis, number of people involved, and whether any investigation or surveillance occurred are unknown. A September 2025 White House memorandum mentioned in supplied research concerns a later date and different stated subject; it does not establish the alleged February action. Keep the claim unpublished until event-specific evidence supports it.
